items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: He used to play a trombone and he played bass, with Paul Whiteman.

ctx.x: And I quit that. So I really got onto wanting to bow. I went to -- I don't know if I can recall this man's name. He used to play a trombone and he played bass, with Paul Whiteman. His name was --
